# Footprint provenance

Selected libraries copied from the official KiCad 10.0.6 macOS distribution,
`KiCad.app/Contents/SharedSupport/footprints`. Upstream:
https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints . License: CC BY-SA 4.0 with
KiCad's board-design exception; see LICENSE.md.

`PinHeader_1x03_P2.54mm_Vertical_OpenSilk` is a local derivative: two decorative
F.SilkS outline segments removed to clear J2 pin labels. Pads, drills, numbering,
courtyard and models are unchanged. Its stock parent remains alongside it.
All other footprint files are unchanged. SHA256SUMS covers every .kicad_mod.
